[FACT] User is planning a trip to Mexico soon.

[PREFERENCE] User is excited to immerse themselves in Mexican culture.  
[EVENT] User is looking forward to exploring attractions and experiences in Mexico.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended must-see attractions in Mexico:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Teotihuacán: UNESCO World Heritage Site with pyramids of the Sun and the Moon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Chichén Itzá: One of the Seven Wonders of the World, featuring the Pyramid of Kukulcán.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Cancún's Hotel Zone: Known for beautiful beaches and a vibrant atmosphere.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Guadalajara's historic center: Home to Hospicio Cabañas, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Tulum's Mayan ruins: Offers breathtaking views and insight into Mayan history.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Coyoacán's Frida Kahlo Museum: Dedicated to the life and work of Frida Kahlo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Guanajuato's colorful streets: A picturesque colonial city and UNESCO World Heritage Site.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended experiences not to miss in Mexico:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Try traditional cuisine: Tacos al pastor, mole poblano, chiles rellenos, and pozole.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Attend a mariachi performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Visit a mercado (market): Mercado de San Juan in Mexico City or Mercado de Abastos in Guadalajara.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Take a cooking class with a local chef.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Participate in Day of the Dead celebrations if traveling in November.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Go on a tequila tour at a distillery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Relax on a beautiful beach: Playa del Carmen, Puerto Vallarta, or Mazatlán.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for traveling in Mexico:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Learn basic Spanish phrases, be mindful of local customs, venture beyond tourist areas, stay hydrated, and wear sunscreen.  
[USER] Asked about the best way to get around Mexico City, considering traffic and safety concerns.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended ways to navigate Mexico City:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Metro: 12 lines covering much of the city
